data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'k-w-y', meaning 'to give'. Kaawiyah means 'gift of God' or 'God's gift'. The name Kaawiyah carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kaawiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaawiyah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
